description: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul appointed a special prosecutor Thursday to oversee an investigation into a woman's allegations that she was gang raped at a Cornell University fraternity house, with the governor saying she had lost faith in the local district attorney's ability to handle the case.
title: New York's governor removes district attorney from Cornell rape allegations case, appoints special prosecutor

description: U.S. President Donald Trump said Thursday that if Iran is linked to the copilot who tried to crash an Israel-bound flight, the Islamic Republic would be struck "very hard" for the attempt on the lives of more than 180 people aboard the jet.
title: Trump threatens to hit Iran 'very hard' if Tehran found to be behind FlyDubai incident

author: Nicole Mortillaro
description: Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk blasted off to the International Space Station for a six-month mission just a few months after fellow Canadian Jeremy Hansen flew around the moon. It's an example of not only Canada's continuing role in space exploration but also how bright the future could be.
title: Joshua Kutryk's launch to the ISS is another example of the important role Canada plays in space exploration

description: A Montreal hospital has isolated a female patient presenting with symptoms of Ebola, a deadly virus, officials said.
title: Montreal hospital isolates patient exhibiting Ebola symptoms

author: John Paul Tasker, Katie Simpson
description: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer says he regularly speaks with his Canadian counterpart, but that the two sides have reached an impasse on some trade irritants and there's no sign of a resolution any time soon.
title: Trump's trade rep sounds pessimistic about deal with Canada, saying issues are 'quite difficult to resolve'

description: British counter-terrorism police investigating a suspected plot involving an air base used by the U.S. ‌to target Iran said on Thursday they had arrested a dual UK-Iranian national on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts.
title: U.K. counter-terror police arrest British-Iranian suspect over Fairford air base investigation

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: Rapper Rick Ross was arrested in Miami Beach on Thursday and charged with domestic violence following an alleged incident, local authorities confirmed to The Associated Press. Ross says he is innocent and the accusations are 'fabricated allegations.'
title: Rapper Rick Ross arrested, charged with battery and accused of domestic violence

description: The judge in the Lindsay Clancy murder case on Thursday refused to declare her not guilty, turning down a defence motion that had argued there wasn't enough evidence to prove she was responsible for killing her three children.
title: Judge denies defence request to declare Lindsay Clancy not guilty

description: Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Thursday the world was living through a dangerous moment and warned the West not to escalate a standoff ‌over Ukraine by threatening the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad, which Moscow has made clear it would defend with nuclear weapons if necessary.
title: Putin warns West not to escalate, claims concerns about Russia's Kaliningrad region

description: Police arrested a 44-year-old Edmonton man accused of threatening to kill Prime Minister Mark Carney, RCMP say.
title: Edmonton man charged for alleged death threat against Mark Carney: RCMP

author: Gloria Henriquez
description: Lawyers are asking a Quebec Superior Court judge to authorize a class-action lawsuit against American fruit giant Driscoll’s. It comes after allegations that the company had sent millions of pounds of berries to Canada with non-compliant levels of chemical residues between 2022 and 2024.
title: Fruit giant Driscoll's faces class-action lawsuit in Quebec

description: Police in Belleville, Ont., say they're investigating antisemitic flyers being distributed in the city less than two weeks after a gunman was killed attempting to attack a local synagogue on Yom Kippur.
title: Belleville, Ont., police investigating antisemitic flyers less than 2 weeks after synagogue attack

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: Macklemore says all three shows of his newly announced tour to raise funds for organizations supporting Palestinians "sold out immediately." This comes less than a week after the four-time Grammy winner announced the three October dates in Dublin, Paris and London, calling it the Free Palestine tour.
title: Macklemore says Free Palestine tour 'sold out immediately'

author: Helen Surgenor
description: Canadian comedian Jim Carrey has tied the knot with Min Ah, the partner he introduced to the public back in February.
title: Jim Carrey marries Min Ah months after going public with relationship

description: Lawsuits filed by Renee Good's family allege wrongful death, conspiracy and other violations in the 37-year-old's fatal shooting by a U.S. immigration officer during an immigration crackdown in January.
title: Renee Good's family sues U.S. government, ICE officer and others over Minneapolis killing

description: Five weeks from now, Americans will cast their ballots in the midterm elections to decide who controls Congress, and right now, Democrats have reason to be encouraged. Washington correspondents Katie Simpson, Willy Lowry and Paul Hunter take a look at where the midterm races are he
title: Democrats are gaining ground. Could Trump still try to curb who can vote?

description: Glaciers in Switzerland lost 5.5 per cent of their ice volume this year, the second-biggest percentage drop on record. It's part of a trend that could have big impacts in a country reliant on hydropower and which acts as the 'water tower of Europe,' feeding its major rivers.
title: This is how fast Swiss glaciers, the 'water tower of Europe,' are melting away

description: Defender Claire Thompson, one of Canada's top women's hockey players, is retiring from the sport to become a doctor. The 28-year-old played with the PWHL's Vancouver Goldeneyes last season.
title: Canadian Olympian Claire Thompson retires from PWHL to pursue medical career

author: Catharine Tunney
description: Building the proposed high‑speed rail project between Toronto and Quebec City could cost between $75 billion and $113 billion — higher than some of the official initial estimates, according to a new report from the Parliamentary Budget Office.
title: Alto high-speed rail project could cost more than originally thought: budget watchdog

description: A sexual assault case against Trailer Park Boys actor Mike Smith was dropped in Dartmouth provincial court on Thursday. The complainant says the trial was dismissed because she was "unwilling to sacrifice" her mental health to go through the criminal justice process.
title: Judge dismisses sexual assault case against Trailer Park Boys star Mike Smith

title: U.A.E. announces investigation into FlyDubai incident

description: Thursday marks a critical milestone in the proposal to construct a new bitumen pipeline from Alberta to Canada's West Coast.
title: Ottawa faces deadline on whether to fast-track new West Coast pipeline

author: Joel Dryden
description: A new poll suggests the group with the highest level of support for Alberta separation is supporters of the United Conservative Party, trumping other groups, including those defined by age, religiosity and education.
title: Poll suggests slight majority of UCP voters favour separation as party stares down ‘tough days’ ahead

description: Christa Pike, convicted of murdering a classmate three decades ago, survived Tennessee's effort to execute her by means of lethal injection late on Wednesday, prison officials said, foiling the state's first attempt to put a woman to death in two centuries.
title: Tennessee governor orders outside review after death row inmate Christa Pike survives execution attempt

description: Mark Carney is asking the world to invest in Canada. But who already owns Canada? And what would more foreign investment mean for our sovereignty?
